pages.text: Rift Shards and Void Fragments drop from late bosses: the Ender Dragon, the Wither, the Warden, the Gaia Guardian, the Aether's dungeon bosses and most of Cataclysm's.$(br2)They go into the $(bold)Mythic Forge$() and its five $(bold)Mythic Catalysts$(). The Engineering capstone quest asks for a Catalyst V, which also takes Antimatter and a Rift Core (5% from the Ancient Remnant).

$(bold)Not in the game yet$()$(br2)$(bold)Oblivion's Rift$(), the dungeon these materials were made for, is designed but not built. Until it is, nothing crafts the Rift Keystone, the Void Coffer, the Mythic Reforge Token or the four Mythic Uniques, and a catalyst cannot be put on gear: Mythic infusion comes with the Rift.
Shards keep. The Rift's recipes are written and stay closed until the Rift is built.$(br2)$(bold)Next: farm Rift Shards from late bosses.$()
